issue.title: Support punctuation in pip command suggestions
issue.body: The pip_unknown_command rule fails when a misspelled command contains punctuation such as '+'. It should return the suggested correction for quoted pip command names instead of raising or missing the replacement.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Honor the platform PATH separator
issue.body: Executable discovery assumes ':' separates PATH entries. On platforms that use another separator, each directory must still be inspected independently.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Avoid git_push false positives from branch text
issue.body: A successful push can mention a branch or URL containing 'set-upstream'. That output must not make the git_push rule report a missing-upstream failure.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Handle apostrophes in existing Git branch names
issue.body: When Git reports that a branch whose name contains an apostrophe already exists, the rule should match and generate valid correction choices without truncating the branch name.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Recognize php -s after other options
issue.body: The php_s rule only recognizes '-s' in one command position. It should match the lowercase server flag when valid PHP options appear before it and preserve the rest of the command.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Do not crash on git push -u without an argument
issue.body: Generating a correction for 'git push -u' raises an indexing error because the short upstream option has no following branch argument. Return the upstream command suggested by Git.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Do not suggest nonexistent manual sections
issue.body: When man explicitly reports that no manual entry exists, the rule should suggest the program's help command only. Otherwise manual-section corrections should precede that fallback.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Avoid duplicated explicit Git upstream arguments
issue.body: When git push already includes -u/--set-upstream and its remote, the correction repeats those arguments. The result should contain them once while retaining unrelated flags.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Ignore not-found text for installed commands
issue.body: The no_command rule can activate when stderr contains 'not found' even though the executable exists. It must only match genuinely unavailable commands.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Support checkout when a Git branch already exists
issue.body: Git emits the same branch-already-exists failure for checkout-based branch creation. The rule should match that form and offer corresponding corrections.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Match current Git pathspec errors
issue.body: Newer Git versions omit the old explanatory suffix from pathspec errors. The git_add rule should still recognize the failure and produce its correction.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Prevent duplicate sudo suggestions
issue.body: The sudo rule must not match permission-denied output when the original command already starts with sudo, otherwise it suggests an invalid duplicate prefix.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Use a lease-protected forced-push correction
issue.body: The git_push_force rule currently proposes an unconditional forced push. It should propose Git's safer lease-protected force mode and preserve remote and branch arguments.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Handle bare git in the stash rule
issue.body: The git_fix_stash matcher raises an indexing error for a bare 'git' command with usage output. It should safely decline when no subcommand is present.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Allow an empty corrected-command sequence
issue.body: Realizing SortedCorrectedCommandsSequence with an empty generator raises an indexing error. Iterating it should simply return no corrections.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Support nested mkdir inside HDFS commands
issue.body: The mkdir_p correction only works when mkdir is the first token. It should add the parent flag to mkdir embedded in hdfs dfs commands without altering their prefix.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Generate valid vagrant up choices
issue.body: Without a machine name the correction includes an extra space. With a name, it should offer starting that machine or all machines before retrying.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Preserve Linux opener commands
issue.body: The open rule recognizes xdg-open, gnome-open, and kde-open but rewrites every correction as macOS open. Add the URL scheme while preserving the opener.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Place --staged after git diff
issue.body: Appending --staged after a path can be parsed incorrectly. Insert it after the diff subcommand while preserving later arguments.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: Do not match commands that merely contain ls
issue.body: The ls_lah rule matches unrelated commands containing the letters ls. It should only match ls as the command and ignore invocations that already have options.

verification.details: Metadata and fixed-version test overlay were checked against the pinned official corpus. Docker buggy/fixed reproduction is not yet recorded.

issue.title: tqdm object cannot be treated as bool when used with opened file
issue.body: A progress wrapper around an open binary file raises TypeError when an HTTP client checks its truth value. The wrapped file has no length method. In the selected buggy revision an explicit total already works, but boolean checks still fail without a total. Support truth-value checks for these unknown-length iterables. Source report: https://github.com/tqdm/tqdm/issues/353 .

verification.details: Focused Docker fail/pass and independent public-symptom checks verified on 2026-10-23. Explicit Python 3.8 port; not a full-suite claim.

issue.title: Choice options are redundant using cookiecutter with latest click package
issue.body: With Cookiecutter 1.6 and Click 7, a choice variable with options a and b prints the choice numbers twice in the final prompt. A user sees both the existing list of numbers and another parenthesized list added by Click. Display the available choices once while preserving selection and default behavior. Source report: https://github.com/cookiecutter/cookiecutter/issues/1167 .

issue.title: Stop build if pre hook fails
issue.body: A pre-generation hook can fail, for example by raising SyntaxError or rejecting missing external dependencies, but project generation continues. Halt generation when a pre-hook fails so an invalid project is not rendered. Source report: https://github.com/cookiecutter/cookiecutter/issues/464 ; upstream resolution: https://github.com/cookiecutter/cookiecutter/pull/549 .
